stories.title: Germany arrests a former spy chief on suspicion of treason and passing state secrets to a foreign power
stories.reason: August Hanning, 80, who led Germany's BND foreign intelligence service from 1998 to 2005, is accused alongside a former aide of arranging in 2010 to have intelligence funneled to him in exchange for payment, in what could be the agency's worst breach since the Cold War.

stories.title: A Siberian lab worker dies of suspected pneumonic plague, prompting WHO and US monitoring
stories.reason: Nearly 200 people are under observation in Irkutsk after the 28-year-old technician died following hospitalization, though Russian authorities have told the WHO no further plague cases have been detected and dispute accounts that she was exposed to live bacteria at the institute.

stories.title: Nvidia closes in on becoming the first company ever worth $6 trillion
stories.reason: The chipmaker's stock is up 30% this year, adding $1.3 trillion in value, with options traders pricing roughly even odds it crosses the threshold by month's end on continued confidence in AI infrastructure demand.

stories.title: Brazil's stock market posts its biggest rally since 2020 after Bolsonaro's first-round election lead
stories.reason: The Bovespa jumped 7.7% to a record close and the real strengthened more than 4% against the dollar after Flavio Bolsonaro's 47.03%-to-45.16% lead over Lula, as investors bet on a market-friendlier outcome in the October 25 runoff.

stories.title: Google signs a 3.6-gigawatt power deal with Constellation Energy to feed its AI data centers
stories.reason: The agreement ranks among the largest corporate electricity procurements ever struck in the US, underscoring how the energy demands of AI infrastructure are reshaping power markets and reviving interest in nuclear generation capacity.

stories.title: Francis Halzen wins the Nobel Prize in Physics for detecting cosmic 'ghost particles'
stories.reason: Halzen's decades-long vision for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory, which uses light sensors buried in a cubic kilometer of Antarctic ice, enabled the discovery of high-energy neutrinos from beyond our galaxy and opened a new kind of astronomy.

stories.title: France suspends high school classes nationwide as protests draw 256,000 people and over 6,100 arrests
stories.reason: Nearly 2,000 high schools were blockaded on the biggest day yet of a three-week movement over understaffed, overcrowded and dilapidated classrooms, prompting PM Lecornu to suspend classes for the rest of the week as police tactics draw scrutiny.

stories.title: DeepSeek nears a $12-15 billion funding round as it builds toward a possible 2027 IPO
stories.reason: Interest in the round exceeded the Chinese AI lab's original $7.4 billion target after its latest model drew strong demand, with backers including Tencent and CATL pushing the deal toward a valuation well above its roughly $74 billion prior mark.
